head: simzy39:fix/d3d12-resource-creation-rollback
title: Fix D3D12 resource creation allocation rollback
body:
Fixes https://github.com/Traverse-Research/gpu-allocator/issues/325.

Return reserved suballocations when placed-resource options or native creation fail. Drop a partial native resource before returning its backing allocation. Convert null-success outputs to internal errors. This is independent of #323 and does not change sizing or caching.

Validation: five COM-stub tests using the public allocator constructor pass; four fail on main. Formatting, strict all-target Clippy and a Rust 1.71 consumer build pass on Windows. No physical OOM is required by the tests.

AI disclosure: an OpenAI coding agent implemented, tested and wrote this description at the contributor's explicit direction.
